g.text: Loss / fee benefit in these separate scenarios
The growth loss is 4.3× the fee benefit in this comparison.
Separate changes from 20% growth and 1.50% fee. OPERF inception-model NPV; 15% assumed discount rate.
"One point" means one percentage point; the two bars are not additive; 4.3× holds only for this comparison.
Source: (Engine!L41 − Engine!L40) × Q3 Base case!C63 = −28.09; Q4 Analysis!C25 = +6.55; 28.09 ÷ 6.55 = 4.29. Sensitivity!B38:C38: break-even growth 19.23% at the
1.50% fee and 19.00% at 1.35% (interpolated; 19.00% is not exactly break-even). Case p. 5 on the exit environment; no delayed-exit loss is modelled.
